description: A candidate that clears its gates and archetype floor and then cannot fill a §15.2 row must be recorded as suppressed (INCOMPLETE_PAYLOAD) with the rows it could not fill, and a candidate that never qualified must not be. Found live 2026-09-20: DOGEUSDT M5 A3, target pool swept by its own candle, dropped with nothing written. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/payload_suppression.json

mutations.name: the old silent guard: a no-payload candidate is dropped without a row
mutations.old:
if candidate.payload is None:
            if candidate.publishable:
mutations.new:
if candidate.payload is None:
            if False:

mutations.name: suppress every no-payload candidate, qualified or not
mutations.old:
if candidate.payload is None:
            if candidate.publishable:
mutations.new:
if candidate.payload is None:
            if True:

mutations.name: report only the first missing row
claim a missing row even when the levels are complete
drop payload_unmet from the recorded reason
